name: Flyerimage
author: thousand31

sections.description:
Flyerimage lets you create, schedule, and manage popup campaigns across your WordPress site using a free-position drag-and-drop canvas editor — no coding required.

Design beautiful popups from scratch or start with one of 6 ready-made templates. Place any element exactly where you want it: headings, text, badges, buttons, form fields, images, shapes, link buttons, and inline text links. Set your targeting rules in plain English — trigger, pages, audience, and frequency — then watch results roll in through per-campaign and site-wide analytics dashboards.

It’s the complete popup toolkit for marketers, store owners, bloggers, and site builders who want professional results without the complexity.

Key Features

  • Free-position drag-and-drop v3 canvas editor
  • 9 element types: Heading, Text, Badge, Button, Field, Image, Shape, Link Button, Link Label
  • 13+ shape variants for flexible design accents
  • 6 starter templates: Email Capture, Discount Offer, Announcement, Exit Intent, Lead Magnet, Newsletter Sign-up
  • Link Button element — styled button that opens any URL in a new tab
  • Link Label element — inline underlined text link; use # to close the popup
  • Form submission capture with anti-spam protection (honeypot + IP rate limiting)
  • Submissions log with campaign filter and CSV export
  • Per-campaign analytics: views, visitors, clicks, closes, submissions, conversion rate, engagement funnel, device split
  • Site-wide analytics dashboard: 7-day KPI highlights, views vs visitors chart, campaign performance comparison
  • 5 trigger types: Time on page, Scroll depth, Exit intent, Click on element, Inactivity
  • Page targeting: All pages, Homepage only, or specific pages
  • Audience filter: First-time, Returning, or Everyone
  • Device targeting: Desktop, Tablet, Mobile
  • Frequency control: once per visitor or repeat
  • Auto-close countdown with configurable delay
  • Multiple close icon styles (Standard, Circle, Boxed, Corner)
  • Desktop and Mobile canvas layouts
  • Clean, beginner-friendly admin dashboard

How It Helps You

  • Launch popups and promotions without writing a single line of code
  • Start in seconds with 6 professionally designed starter templates
  • Capture leads and emails directly from your popup with built-in form fields
  • Keep spam out with honeypot detection and IP rate limiting
  • Know what’s working with per-campaign analytics and conversion tracking
  • Show the right popup to the right audience with flexible targeting rules
  • Manage every campaign from one clean dashboard

License

Flyerimage is free software, licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

License URI

https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

Added
* v3 canvas editor — free-position drag-and-drop popup designer with heading, text, badge, button, field, image, shape, link button, and link label elements
* Link Button element — styled button that opens a URL in a new tab
* Link Label element — inline text link with optional underline; setting href to # closes the popup
* Per-campaign analytics page — views over time chart, funnel, device split, top pages, and submission log
* Views (10d) column in campaign list now links directly to campaign analytics
* Anti-spam protection for form submissions — honeypot field and IP rate limiting (10/hour)
* 6 starter templates: Email Capture, Discount Offer, Announcement, Exit Intent, Lead Magnet, Newsletter Sign-up
* Auto-close countdown pill now clears immediately when popup is closed via any action

Improved
* Analytics page: submissions KPI card, conversion rate card, submissions funnel step, and per-campaign submission counts in the campaign table
* Views vs Visitors chart changed to smooth line chart
* Real-time canvas updates — content field now updates on every keystroke

2.3.2

Added
* Image shadow customization support
* Shape shadow customization support
* Duplicate campaign functionality
* Size editing support for individual components
* Improved component editing controls
* Responsive mobile layout fallback (desktop design copied to mobile automatically)

Fixed
* Activate label displaying as @@Activate in campaign list row actions

2.3.1

  • Fixed modal size issue in edit mode

2.3.0

  • Added 2 starter templates (Announcement, Event)
  • Added 13 shape elements
  • Added multiple close icon styles
  • Improved campaign builder UX and element controls
  • General UI improvements

2.2.0

Added
– Rectangle element added to toolbox
– Display target options (All Pages / Homepage Only)
– Move element forward and backward controls
– Background color support for canvas
– Tip modal and contextual canvas guidance

Improved
– Toolbar redesigned for better usability
– Left panel layout and sizing improvements
– Canvas spacing and placement refinements
– Hover shadow effects on components
– Background image options with scroll support
– Text component styling enhancements

Fixed
– Caching-related rendering issue resolved
– Saving issue fixed
– Duplicate item removal bug fixed
– Minor UI inconsistencies and spacing corrections

2.1.0

  • Automatically copy desktop layout to mobile by default
  • Fixed issue when saving multiple selected pages
  • Added background color option for campaigns
  • Improved Preview button placement
  • Minor i18n improvements

2.0.0

  • Updated minimum PHP requirement to PHP 8.0
  • Renamed “Flyers” to “Campaigns” across the plugin UI
  • Improved campaign list and empty-state experience
  • Enhanced onboarding clarity for first-time users
  • General UI and stability improvements

upgrade_notice.3.0.0: Major release. Introduces a fully rebuilt v3 canvas editor with free-position drag-and-drop elements, link button and link label elements, per-campaign analytics dashboard, anti-spam form submission protection, and 6 new starter templates.
upgrade_notice.2.3.2: Adds image and shape shadow customization, duplicate campaign, size editing per component, improved editing controls, and mobile layout fallback. Fixes Activate label showing as @@Activate in campaign list row actions.
upgrade_notice.2.3.1: Fixes modal size issue in edit mode. Recommended update for all users.
upgrade_notice.2.3.0: Adds starter templates, new shapes, and improved customization options for a better campaign creation experience.
upgrade_notice.2.2.0: Added new rectangle tool and display targeting options. Redesigned toolbar and improved editor layout. Fixed caching and saving issues. General UI and performance improvements.
upgrade_notice.2.1.0: Improved mobile responsiveness, added background color option, and fixed page-saving issues.
upgrade_notice.2.0.0: This release updates core terminology from "Flyers" to "Campaigns" and requires PHP 8.0 or higher. Please ensure your server meets the PHP requirement before upgrading.

screenshots.caption: Live popup on the front-end — Announcement template with a call-to-action button, link label, and auto-close countdown.
Campaign list dashboard showing all campaigns with trigger, pages, audience, frequency, closes, 10-day sparkline views, and status.
Campaign row actions menu — Edit, Submissions, Analytics, Preview, Duplicate, Deactivate, and Delete.
Template selector — choose from Blank canvas, Email Capture, Discount Offer, Announcement, Exit Intent, Lead Magnet, and Newsletter Sign-up.
v3 canvas editor (Design tab) — free-position drag-and-drop with element toolbar, layers panel, and popup style sidebar.
Rules tab — Trigger, Pages, and Audience settings with a plain-English summary and sanity checks.
Submissions log — all form entries across campaigns with date, page URL, field values, and CSV export.
Per-campaign analytics — Views, Unique Visitors, Clicks, Closes, Submissions, and Conversion Rate KPIs with a Views Over Time chart and Engagement Funnel.
Site-wide analytics dashboard — 7-day highlight KPIs with trend indicators, Engagement Funnel, and Action Breakdown.
Site-wide analytics continued — Views vs Visitors line chart and Campaign Performance comparison bar chart.
